# Source provenance

Original website: https://motion-reference.takayustudio.jp/

Motion Movement Reference by たかゆ (Takayu). Its complete underlying parameter database has **not** been retrieved or validated for this repository.

`presets.json` holds independently authored starter examples, **not source-site parameters**.

For local, user-directed inspection, use `scripts/capture_site.py`. Its screenshots and metadata are unverified until manually compared with the selected references. Web Animations API results can omit animations rendered via canvas or other systems.

Respect site terms, attribution and permission requirements. Do not redistribute copyrighted imagery, video, proprietary site code, or a bulk-copied catalog without authorization.
